value.rationale: The ternary midpoint question language captures order only up to global reversal, yielding a natural online learnability invariant not reducible by name to pairwise comparisons. The result isolates the first obstruction to the generic cardinality depth at exactly six labels, proves a sharp improved bound through eight despite an 8192-leaf witness, and locates the first adaptive-versus-static gap at four labels. These threshold and full finite-range facts are motivated by sharpness of a universal one-third-root counting obstruction, not arbitrary slices.
